name: Tsukino Kotoha
source:
A charismatic and popular girl whose father - the [url=/c82146]protagonist's[/url] ex-best friend - was a hypnotist. She uses her hypnosis skills and charm as a leader on others in order to do anything she wants at school. She is also childhood friends with [url=/c81786]Ayaka[/url] and [url=/c81788]Ema[/url].

The hypnosis skill she is good at is "vision"; she can make people see hallucinations.
